# MCP Tool Reference

This document is generated directly from registered MCP metadata and the live Cobra command tree. Regenerate it after changing a tool or CLI command.

## Common result contract

Every call preserves `content[0].text` and returns `structuredContent` using `ncgo.mcp.result/v1`: `schemaVersion`, `ok`, `data`, `effects`, `diagnostics`, `error`, and `nextSteps`. Failures expose stable `code`, `message`, `retryable`, optional `path`, and `remediation` fields. “Stable result fields” below lists the tool's public fields: non-reserved fields live in `data`, while reserved `ok`, `effects`, `diagnostics`, and `nextSteps` fields live in the envelope. Matching legacy top-level fields remain during migration.

## Registered tools

### `ncgo_version`

Return ncgo, build, and embedded assets versions.

- CLI equivalent: `ncgo version`
- Output formats: `text`
- Stable result fields: `content[0].text`
- Safety/execution hints: read-only, idempotent
- Side effects: None.

| Input | Required | Type / values | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| _None_ | — | — | — |

### `ncgo_new`

Scaffold a new ncgo service or micro workspace. No dryRun is available because the authoritative hz/kitex generators do not expose a non-mutating render API; run in a disposable target directory when a preview is required.

- CLI equivalent: `ncgo new`
- Output formats: `text|json`
- Stable result fields: `dir`, `mode`, `ranGenerate`, `autoSteps`, `nextSteps`
- Safety/execution hints: network, external process
- Side effects: Creates a project tree and may run hz/kitex, Go commands, and Agent sync. No dry-run; use a disposable target to preview.

| Input | Required | Type / values | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `aiTarget` | no | string | AI sync target for post-generation: all (default) \| agents \| claude \| cursor \| none |
| `db` | no | postgres \| none |  |
| `dir` | no | string | Target directory relative to the MCP workspace, default ./&lt;name&gt; |
| `infra` | no | array&lt;string&gt; | Infra add-ons (currently: redis) |
| `kind` | no | hertz \| kitex |  |
| `mode` | no | mono \| micro |  |
| `module` | yes | string | Go module path, e.g. "github.com/acme/user-api" |
| `name` | yes | string | Service name, e.g. "user-api" |
| `noAutoSteps` | no | boolean | Skip automatic post-generation steps (go mod tidy, ai sync) |
| `noGenerate` | no | boolean | Skip generator invocation |
| `output` | no | text \| json |  |
| `preset` | no | string | Preset name: rule-center (Kitex with rate-limiting CRUD schema) |
| `ruleCenterAddr` | no | string | Rule-center gRPC address; sets Hertz source.type=rule_center |
| `template` | no | string | Template package name from registry |
| `templateDir` | no | string | Template package directory relative to the MCP workspace |

### `ncgo_upgrade`

- Output formats: `text|json`
- Stable result fields: `upToDate`, `root`, `mode`, `path`, `plan`, `items`
- Safety/execution hints: read-only, idempotent
- Side effects: None through MCP; returns a metadata upgrade plan only. CLI can apply the upgrade.

| Input | Required | Type / values | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `output` | no | text \| json |  |
| `root` | yes | string | Project root containing .ncgo/manifest.yaml or ncgo.workspace; must be relative to the MCP server workspace |

- Output formats: `text|json`
- Stable result fields: `outputDir`, `kind`, `templates`, `idls`
- Safety/execution hints: destructive, idempotent
- Side effects: Writes derived template and IDL snapshots under template/; no dry-run.

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | no | hertz \| kitex |  |

### `ncgo_template_list`

Refresh the registry cache with git clone/pull, then list available template packages. No dryRun is available because the registry client has no offline or read-only listing mode.

- CLI equivalent: `ncgo template list`
- Output formats: `text|json`
- Stable result fields: `templates`
- Safety/execution hints: destructive, network, external process
- Side effects: Runs git clone/pull and mutates the local registry cache; requires network for remote registries.

| Input | Required | Type / values | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `output` | no | text \| json |  |
| `registry` | no | string | Template registry URL (default: NCGO_REGISTRY env or official registry) |

### `ncgo_template_pull`

Fetch a template package into the local registry cache. No dryRun is available because resolving the remote package and populating the cache are performed atomically by the registry client; ncgo_template_list can inspect names but also refreshes that cache.

- CLI equivalent: `ncgo template pull`
- Output formats: `text|json`
- Stable result fields: `name`, `dir`
- Safety/execution hints: destructive, network, external process
- Side effects: Runs git clone/pull and updates the local registry cache; no dry-run.

| Input | Required | Type / values | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | yes | string | Template package name to pull, e.g. "base-kitex" |
| `output` | no | text \| json |  |
| `registry` | no | string | Template registry URL (default: NCGO_REGISTRY env or official registry) |

- CLI equivalent: `ncgo add rpc`
- Output formats: `text|json`
- Stable result fields: `serviceDir`, `serviceRel`, `module`, `updated`, `ranGenerate`, `dryRun`, `plan`, `nextSteps`

| `template` | no | string | Template package name from registry (kitex or micro kind) |
| `templateDir` | no | string | Template package directory relative to the MCP workspace (kitex or micro kind) |

## CLI ↔ MCP capability matrix

| CLI capability | MCP tool | Status / reason |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ncgo add bff` | `ncgo_add_bff` | Both scaffold the service; CLI additionally writes per-service .claude directories. |
| `ncgo add domain` | `ncgo_add_domain` | Available through both interfaces; see the tool contract above for MCP-specific preview/apply behavior. |
| `ncgo add infra` | `ncgo_add_infra` | Available through both interfaces; see the tool contract above for MCP-specific preview/apply behavior. |
| `ncgo add kitex-client` | — | Not exposed through MCP yet; use the CLI dry-run/plan before applying. |
| `ncgo add method` | `ncgo_add_method` | Both apply the edit; MCP additionally supports dryRun, while CLI has no preview flag. |
| `ncgo add rpc` | `ncgo_add_rpc` | Both scaffold the service; CLI additionally writes per-service .claude directories. |
| `ncgo add rpc-method` | `ncgo_add_rpc_method` | Both apply the edit; MCP additionally supports dryRun, while CLI has no preview flag. |
| `ncgo add rule-center` | `ncgo_add_rule_center` | Available through both interfaces; see the tool contract above for MCP-specific preview/apply behavior. |
| `ncgo ai init claude` | `ncgo_ai_init_claude` | Available through both interfaces; see the tool contract above for MCP-specific preview/apply behavior. |
| `ncgo ai sync` | `ncgo_ai_sync` | Available through both interfaces; see the tool contract above for MCP-specific preview/apply behavior. |
| `ncgo check` | `ncgo_check` | Available through both interfaces; see the tool contract above for MCP-specific preview/apply behavior. |
| `ncgo completion` | — | Shell integration is intentionally CLI-only. |
| `ncgo doctor` | `ncgo_doctor` | Available through both interfaces; see the tool contract above for MCP-specific preview/apply behavior. |
| `ncgo export templates` | `ncgo_export_templates` | Available through both interfaces; see the tool contract above for MCP-specific preview/apply behavior. |
| `ncgo extract domain` | `ncgo_extract_domain` | MCP is plan-only; CLI can copy files with --apply. |
| `ncgo help` | — | Interactive command help is intentionally CLI-only. |
| `ncgo i18n check` | `ncgo_i18n_check` | Available through both interfaces; see the tool contract above for MCP-specific preview/apply behavior. |
| `ncgo i18n report` | `ncgo_i18n_report` | Available through both interfaces; see the tool contract above for MCP-specific preview/apply behavior. |
| `ncgo import` | `ncgo_import` | MCP is preview-only; CLI writes .ncgo/manifest.yaml. |
| `ncgo mcp serve` | — | Starts the MCP transport itself and therefore is not an MCP tool. |
| `ncgo new` | `ncgo_new` | Shared scaffold capability; CLI additionally supports interactive module collection and --idl, which MCP does not expose. |
| `ncgo protolint` | `ncgo_protolint` | Available through both interfaces; see the tool contract above for MCP-specific preview/apply behavior. |
| `ncgo template list` | `ncgo_template_list` | Available through both interfaces; see the tool contract above for MCP-specific preview/apply behavior. |
| `ncgo template pull` | `ncgo_template_pull` | Available through both interfaces; see the tool contract above for MCP-specific preview/apply behavior. |
| `ncgo test rate-limit e2e` | — | Orchestrates local dependencies, traffic, and report files; intentionally CLI-only. |
| `ncgo test rate-limit run` | — | Runs local traffic tools and network calls; intentionally CLI-only. |
| `ncgo test rate-limit seed` | — | Mutates a local test database; intentionally CLI-only. |
| `ncgo upgrade` | `ncgo_upgrade` | MCP is preview-only; CLI can apply metadata updates. |
| `ncgo version` | `ncgo_version` | Available through both interfaces; see the tool contract above for MCP-specific preview/apply behavior. |
| — | `ncgo_ai_context` | MCP-only structured project context; there is no direct CLI equivalent. |
